pats.definition:
n the sound made by a gentle blow
n a light touch or stroke
v pat or squeeze fondly or playfully, especially under the chin
v hit lightly
pats.translation: abbr. 通讯系统状态分析（Performance Analysis of Telecommunication Systems）；优先活性追踪系统（priority activity tracking system）
